=== CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===
- scripts/pr_checks_lib.sh:4397 | severity=critical | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3, openai_gpt-6-luna, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: In `_merge_lease_gate_multi`, `gm_excluded="${MERGE_LEASE_GATE_SOURCE_ORPHANS:-}"` overwrites the holder exclusions built at lines 4377-4388 (`gm_excluded="${gm_excluded:+${gm_excluded},}${gm_h}"`) instead of appending to them, so the queue scan at line 4408 (`_merge_lease_queue_first ... "${gm_excluded}"`) no longer skips live holders.
  WHY: A holder that still carries `ai:merge-lease-wait` (before the best-effort unlabel runs, or after a failed unlabel) can be returned as `gm_first`; it then costs an extra `_merge_lease_pr_paths` read (line 4418), takes one of the 10 candidate slots (line 4411), and can turn a clean join into `queued_behind` with the blocker set to a live holder, a regression against main (the tick paths in scripts/review_merge_train.sh append correctly); one-line fix: `gm_excluded="${gm_excluded:+${gm_excluded},}${MERGE_LEASE_GATE_SOURCE_ORPHANS:-}"`. Severity disagreement: google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite said BLOCKER and the other four said MAJOR, so the highest is used.
- scripts/pr_checks_lib.sh:2280-2284 | severity=low | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3, openai_gpt-6-luna, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: The orphan path in `_merge_lease_gate_source_issue_skip` (lines 3044-3049) returns 1 with MERGE_LEASE_REASON=source_issue_not_planned, leaves MERGE_LEASE_BLOCKER empty and adds no wait label, but the caller in `_pr_base_fresh_for_merge` still prints the generic "held by or queued for PR #?" / "is labelled ... and is re-dispatched when the lease is granted to it" message.
  WHY: The tick never grants an orphan, so the message gives the operator who must decide on the orphan by hand the wrong guidance and claims a wait label that does not exist; PR_BASE_FRESHNESS_LAST_REASON is correct and only the human-readable line is wrong. All five reviewers said NIT.
- scripts/pr_checks_lib.sh:3031-3038 | severity=high | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3, openai_gpt-6-luna]
  PROBLEM: `_merge_lease_gate_source_issue_skip`, called from `_merge_lease_gate` line 4568 and `_merge_lease_gate_multi` line 4396, counts the current PR as a labelled waiter even when it has no label, so every qualifying update-mode gate run for a same-repository ai/issue-<n> PR makes a batched source-issue GraphQL read with no cycle-local cache.
  WHY: This adds API cost on the shared GraphQL budget on every review/update run, on top of the tick's per-base read, contrary to the issue's "no new read per pull request" / "Use data the tick already has, or one batched read for the candidates" constraint; the read is batched and fails open. Severity disagreement: google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite and openai_gpt-6-luna said MAJOR, while anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5 and minimax_minimax-m3 said NIT, so the highest is used. z-ai_glm-5_3-flash explicitly did not flag this, calling it documented, deliberate design.
=== END CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===

  confidence=3

=== END CONSENSUS TASK GAPS ===

=== FINDINGS FROM anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5 ===
- scripts/pr_checks_lib.sh:_merge_lease_gate_multi, line 4397: gm_excluded="${MERGE_LEASE_GATE_SOURCE_ORPHANS:-}" | severity=MAJOR | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: Overwrites gm_excluded instead of adding to it; the holders added by the loop at lines 4377-4388 (line 4380) are replaced by the orphan list (normally empty), so the queue scan at line 4408 no longer skips holders.
  WHY: Line 3802 accepts any wait-labelled row and line 3805 skips only excluded rows, so a still-labelled holder can come back as gm_first. That causes an extra pull-files read (line 4418), uses up one of the 10 candidate slots (line 4411) and can cause a wrong queued_behind with the blocker set to a live holder (lines 4434-4436). This is a regression against main; the fix is 1 line, and no test covers _merge_lease_gate_multi with the guard on.
- scripts/pr_checks_lib.sh:_merge_base_freshness caller, lines 2280-2284 | severity=NIT | confidence=3
  PROBLEM: The orphan path (lines 3044-3049) returns 1 with MERGE_LEASE_REASON=source_issue_not_planned and an empty MERGE_LEASE_BLOCKER, but the caller prints the generic "queued for PR #?" / re-dispatch message.
  WHY: The tick never grants an orphan, so the owner gets the wrong guidance; PR_BASE_FRESHNESS_LAST_REASON is correct.
- scripts/pr_checks_lib.sh:_merge_lease_gate_source_issue_skip, lines 3031-3038, called from _merge_lease_gate line 4568 and _merge_lease_gate_multi line 4396 | severity=NIT | confidence=2
  PROBLEM: The current PR is counted as a labelled waiter even when it is unlabelled, so every non-renewal update gate for an ai/issue-<n> PR makes a GraphQL issue-state read (batched, one per gate run).
  WHY: This is a steady extra API cost on the shared GraphQL budget beyond what G4 asked for; nothing is functionally wrong, and the read fails open.
- TASK_GAP
  Requirement: "scripts/unblock_judge.sh: gather the own-PR facts next to the existing owner facts ... and pass them in the context JSON; add them to the judge prompt's evidence block." (issue #10121, Approach step 1)
  Expected change site: prompts/mode-judge-unblock.txt and its template (the evidence description)
  Evidence of absence: own_pull_requests is added at scripts/unblock_judge.sh line 3093 and copied into the prompt at line 3124, but prompts/mode-judge-unblock.txt never mentions it. G2 is enforced in code, and the item was deferred twice as outside files_touched.
  SEVERITY: NIT
  ISSUE_CONFIDENCE: 2
- HARDENING_SUGGESTIONS (2 related items): the 1-line append fix at _merge_lease_gate_multi line 4397, and a 4-line orphan-specific message at _merge_base_freshness lines 2281-2283. HARDENING_RISK_SCORE: 3
=== END FINDINGS FROM anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5 ===

=== FINDINGS FROM google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite ===
- scripts/pr_checks_lib.sh:4397 | severity=BLOCKER | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: The gm_excluded assignment overwrites the existing exclusions from _merge_lease_skips_effective instead of appending.
  WHY: The holder exclusions built in the previous lines are dropped, which can let blocked or invalid holders into the queue and affects the correctness of lease acquisition.
- scripts/pr_checks_lib.sh:2280-2284 | severity=NIT | confidence=3
  PROBLEM: When an orphan is skipped, the operator receives a generic "queued for PR" message instead of the specific skip reason.
  WHY: It misleads the operator about why the PR is not advancing.
- scripts/pr_checks_lib.sh:3037-3038 | severity=MAJOR | confidence=5
  PROBLEM: Repeated GraphQL API calls are made for every PR update that triggers the lease gate, instead of using the data the tick already fetched.
  WHY: This adds excessive API load, can hit rate limits, and uses shared resources inefficiently.
- TASK_GAP
  Requirement: "scripts/unblock_judge.sh: gather the own-PR facts next to the existing owner facts ... and pass them in the context JSON; add them to the judge prompt's evidence block."
  Expected change site: prompts/mode-judge-unblock.txt (and template), evidence block.
  Evidence of absence: own_pull_requests is added to context.json via scripts/unblock_actions.py and scripts/unblock_judge.sh, but prompts/mode-judge-unblock.txt is unmodified, so the model is never told to consider the field.
  SEVERITY: MAJOR
  ISSUE_CONFIDENCE: 3
=== END FINDINGS FROM google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite ===

=== FINDINGS FROM minimax_minimax-m3 ===
- scripts/pr_checks_lib.sh:line 4397 inside `_merge_lease_gate_multi`, immediately after the helper call at line 4396 | severity=MAJOR | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: `gm_excluded="${MERGE_LEASE_GATE_SOURCE_ORPHANS:-}"` wipes the holder list built at lines 4377-4388 before the queue scan at line 4408, so existing holders can be returned as `gm_first`; `_merge_lease_gate` (line 4568) is unaffected.
  WHY: A still-labelled holder (in the race window before `_merge_lease_unlabel_wait` at line 4632, or after a failed unlabel) causes redone overlap work at lines 4418/4421-4428 and takes one of the 10 candidate slots (line 4411) until it is re-excluded at line 4431, so a clean join can become `queued_behind`. `scripts/review_merge_train.sh:2622` appends correctly.
- scripts/pr_checks_lib.sh:lines 2280-2284 in `_pr_base_fresh_for_merge`, the post-`_merge_lease_gate` branch | severity=NIT | confidence=3
  PROBLEM: On the source_issue_not_planned path, `MERGE_LEASE_BLOCKER` is unset and the lease is never granted, yet the message says "held by or queued for PR #?" and "is re-dispatched when the lease is granted to it."
  WHY: The operator expects the lease to free up; the orphan never takes it, so the debugging path leads nowhere.
- scripts/pr_checks_lib.sh:`_merge_lease_gate_source_issue_skip` at lines 3037-3038, called from `_merge_lease_gate` line 4568 and `_merge_lease_gate_multi` line 4396 | severity=NIT | confidence=3
  PROBLEM: Every update-mode gate call invokes `_merge_lease_source_issue_orphans`, which issues a GraphQL read with no cycle-local cache, unlike the ticks' one batched read per base; non-`ai/issue-*` PRs cost nothing.
  WHY: This breaks the issue's constraint §15, "no new read per pull request", and re-reads the same source-issue facts across in-flight runs.
- TASK_GAP
  Requirement: "scripts/unblock_judge.sh: gather the own-PR facts next to the existing owner facts ... and pass them in the context JSON; add them to the judge prompt's evidence block." (issue #10121, Approach step 1)
  Expected change site: the judge prompt's evidence section, prompts/mode-judge-unblock.txt (and its template)
  Evidence of absence: `own_pull_requests` is added at `scripts/unblock_judge.sh:3093`, but no file in `prompts/` references it. This is a documentation gap rather than a runtime regression (G2 is enforced in code), but it makes wasted `reissue` verdicts more likely.
  SEVERITY: NIT
  ISSUE_CONFIDENCE: 3
- HARDENING_SUGGESTIONS (2 related items): the 1-line append fix at line 4397 in `_merge_lease_gate_multi`, and a 4-line source_issue_not_planned message branch at lines 2281-2283. HARDENING_RISK_SCORE: 3
=== END FINDINGS FROM minimax_minimax-m3 ===
